discoveryMethod: First-party English and French discovery plus bounded inspection of the official City ArcGIS REST service.
sourceReview: The City of Pickering is evidenced as the local GIS/map custodian: its official page links the interactive Map Portal and Open Data Portal, and the official ArcGIS REST directory identifies the General Map service with Pickering City Development Department copyright. This establishes local public GIS custody, but not an open cadastral parcel adapter. The published service layers do not include parcels.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official City page loaded. It links the Pickering Map Portal and Open Data Portal and describes map feature search/identification. No parcel schema or parcel-download URL was embedded in the inspected page.

Official ArcGIS REST directory loaded. Service spatial reference is EPSG:26917; supported query formats include JSON and GeoJSON. Published layers are Pickering road symbols, address points, road labels, pipeline, railroad, road centreline/edge, water courses, surrounding roads, municipal boundary, buildings, 407 right of way, water bodies, and boundary clip. No cadastral parcel layer is listed.
